key.query: What studies link unintended pregnancy history to desire for sterilization reversal?

evidence.title: PubMed 21764126 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: Randomized controlled trials showed that the excision technique is associated with a higher pregnancy rate and a lower rate of recurrence although it may determine severe injury to the ovarian reserve.

evidence.title: PubMed 16034960 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: It was also associated with a subsequent increased rate of spontaneous pregnancy women who had documented prior sub-fertility (OR 5.21 CI 2.04-13.29). AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: There is some evidence that excisional surgery for endometriomata provides for a more favourable outcome than drainage and ablation, with regard to the recurrence of the endometrioma, recurrence of symptoms and subsequent spontaneous pregnancy in women who were previously subfertile.

evidence.title: PubMed 19610053 [abstract]
evidence.cited_text: It was determined that gamma sterilization was the preferred sterilization method of choice for this device.
